spans.claim: Antony Bartle died suddenly in Eldrick's office
spans.anchor: he just sat down, laid his head back, and died
spans.span: He just sat down, laid his head back, and died.

spans.claim: Pratt stole the will from Bartle's pocket
spans.anchor: he unbuttoned Antony Bartle's coat, and drew a folded paper from the inner pocket
spans.span: And then, without hesitation, and with fingers that remained as steady as if nothing had happened, he unbuttoned Antony Bartle's coat, and drew a folded paper from the inner pocket.

spans.claim: Parrawhite threatened Pratt about the will
spans.anchor: I heard everything, I tell you!--and saw everything
spans.span: I heard everything, I tell you!--and saw everything.

spans.claim: Parrawhite was murdered and body weighted with iron
spans.anchor: He fetched a quantity of the iron, fastened it to the dead man's clothing
spans.span: He fetched a quantity of the iron, fastened it to the dead man's clothing, drew the body, thus weighted, to the edge of the pit, and prepared to slide it into the black water.

spans.claim: Mrs. Mallathorpe locked the dangerous foot-bridge gates
spans.anchor: she herself went back to the foot-bridge and secured its wicket gates at both ends
spans.span: But she immediately went to the estate carpenter's shop, and there she procured two short lengths of chain, and two padlocks, and she herself went back to the foot-bridge and secured its wicket gates at both ends.

spans.claim: Murgatroyd booked a passage for Parrawhite to America
spans.anchor: he booked him his passage, for which he paid you whatever it was

spans.claim: Duplicate will found in John Mallathorpe's clothes
spans.anchor: I saw them, and I thought I'd see what they were. And this was one
spans.span: I never looked at them until this very day--but this morning I happened to open that box, and I saw them, and I thought I'd see what they were. And this was one--you see, it's in a plain envelope--it was sealed, but there's no writing on it.

spans.claim: Pratt obtained power of attorney from Mrs. Mallathorpe
spans.anchor: Mrs. Mallathorpe has put him in charge of her affairs

spans.claim: Pratt murdered Parrawhite to silence him
spans.anchor: Pratt murdered Parrawhite on the night of November twenty-third last
spans.span: I am certain that Pratt murdered Parrawhite on the night of November twenty-third last.

spans.claim: Pratt committed suicide when cornered
spans.anchor: And now, without the least hesitation, he drew it out and sent one of its bullets through his brain
spans.span: And now, without the least hesitation, he drew it out and sent one of its bullets through his brain.

spans.claim: Esther Mawson drugged Pratt and stole documents
spans.anchor: I drugged him. There's something afoot--something gone wrong with his schemes
spans.span: I drugged him. There's something afoot--something gone wrong with his schemes--at Barford, and he came here on his way--elsewhere.

spans.claim: Mrs. Mallathorpe burned the will
spans.anchor: she tore them into fragments and flung the fragments in the fire
spans.span: Then she tore them into fragments and flung the fragments in the fire--and as they blazed up, she turned and looked at Esther Mawson in a way which made Esther shrink a little.

spans.claim: Mrs. Gaukrodger found the duplicate will
spans.anchor: I cut the envelope open, and drew the paper out, and I saw at once it was Mr. John Mallathorpe's will
spans.span: I cut the envelope open, and drew the paper out, and I saw at once it was Mr. John Mallathorpe's will--so I came straight to you with it.

spans.claim: Pratt used forged telegram to fake Parrawhite's escape
spans.anchor: I want you, tomorrow morning, early, to send a telegram to these people
spans.span: I want you, tomorrow morning, early, to send a telegram to these people, Halstead & Byner, St.

spans.claim: Police found Parrawhite's body in the quarry pit
spans.anchor: Parrawhite's body has been found
spans.span: Parrawhite's body has been found," he said quietly.

spans.claim: Pratt fled after seeing police at Murgatroyd's
spans.anchor: he never came out, and finally my man made an excuse and asked for him there
spans.span: I'd a man watching for him outside his lodgings from an early hour this morning, but he never came out, and finally my man made an excuse and asked for him there, and then he heard that he'd never been home last night.

spans.claim: Pratt blackmailed Mrs. Mallathorpe with the will
spans.anchor: Pratt held power of attorney and controlled Mrs. Mallathorpe's affairs

spans.claim: The will disposes estate away from Mallathorpe family
spans.anchor: he left everything he possessed to the town of Barford for an educational trust

spans.claim: Pratt's death ends the case
spans.anchor: Pratt's dead body, with a revolver wound, was found in the old part of the house

spans.claim: The false telegram misled investigators
spans.anchor: he wired to Halstead & Byner to say that he booked Parrawhite to New York last November
